newsitem.title: USA: Republic Security to buy County Financial.
newsitem.headline: Republic Security to buy County Financial.

text.p: Republic Security Financial Corp said on Friday it has agreed to acquire County Financial Corp, a Florida bank holding company with $238 million in assets.
Republic said in a statement that it will issue about 6.1 million shares of stock in the acquisition, valued at approximately $56.0 million.
Republic Security said the deal will result in a bank holding company with $860 million in assets with 30 branch offices in Palm Beach, Broward and Date counties.
The deal is expected to be immediately accretive to earnings per share and tangible book value , the company said.
County Financial president and chief executive George Apelian will continue as a senior executive at the bank and join the board, Republic Security said.
